mapper.select: SELECT saving_id AS savingId, product_type AS productType, is_active AS isActive, fin_prdt_cd AS finPrdtCd, kor_co_nm AS korCoNm, product_name AS productName, min_limit AS minLimit, max_limit AS maxLimit, save_trm AS saveTrm, basic_rate AS basicRate, max_rate AS maxRate, is_tax_exempt AS isTaxExempt, gov_match_rate AS govMatchRate FROM ( SELECT saving_id, product_type, is_active, fin_prdt_cd, kor_co_nm, product_name, min_limit, max_limit, save_trm, basic_rate, max_rate, is_tax_exempt, gov_match_rate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY fin_prdt_cd ORDER BY max_rate DESC, save_trm DESC ) AS rn FROM saving_product WHERE product_type = #{productType} AND is_active = TRUE AND del_yn = 'N' ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY max_rate DESC, product_name

SELECT saving_id AS savingId, product_type AS productType, is_active AS isActive, fin_prdt_cd AS finPrdtCd, kor_co_nm AS korCoNm, product_name AS productName, join_member AS joinMember, min_limit AS minLimit, max_limit AS maxLimit, save_trm AS saveTrm, basic_rate AS basicRate, max_rate AS maxRate, is_tax_exempt AS isTaxExempt, gov_match_rate AS govMatchRate, product_link AS productLink FROM saving_product WHERE fin_prdt_cd = #{finPrdtCd} AND is_active = TRUE AND del_yn = 'N'

SELECT policy_id AS policyId, policy_name AS policyName, min_limit AS minLimit, max_limit AS maxLimit, save_trm_note AS saveTrmNote, has_calculator AS hasCalculator, max_rate AS maxRate, normal_match_rate AS normalMatchRate, prefer_match_rate AS preferMatchRate FROM policy_product WHERE policy_status = TRUE AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY max_rate DESC, policy_name

SELECT policy_id AS policyId, policy_name AS policyName, benefits AS benefits, join_member AS joinMember, min_limit AS minLimit, max_limit AS maxLimit, save_trm_note AS saveTrmNote, policy_link AS policyLink, has_calculator AS hasCalculator FROM policy_product WHERE policy_id = #{policyId} AND policy_status = TRUE AND del_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO saving_product ( product_type, is_active, fin_prdt_cd, kor_co_nm, product_name, join_member, etc_note, intr_rate_type, rsrv_type, save_trm, spcl_cnd, basic_rate, max_rate, max_limit, is_tax_exempt, gov_match_rate, created_date, created_nm, del_yn ) VALUES ( #{productType}, #{isActive}, #{finPrdtCd}, #{korCoNm}, #{productName}, #{joinMember}, #{etcNote}, #{intrRateType}, #{rsrvType}, #{saveTrm}, #{spclCnd}, #{basicRate}, #{maxRate}, #{maxLimit}, FALSE, 0.0, NOW(), 'fss-sync', 'N' ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_active = VALUES(is_active), kor_co_nm = VALUES(kor_co_nm), product_name = VALUES(product_name), join_member = VALUES(join_member), etc_note = VALUES(etc_note), intr_rate_type = VALUES(intr_rate_type), rsrv_type = VALUES(rsrv_type), spcl_cnd = VALUES(spcl_cnd), basic_rate = VALUES(basic_rate), max_rate = VALUES(max_rate), max_limit = VALUES(max_limit), modified_date = NOW(), modified_nm = 'fss-sync'
mapper.select: SELECT card_id AS cardId, category AS category, card_name AS cardName, card_type AS cardType, card_qual AS cardQual, card_desc AS cardDesc, card_url AS cardUrl FROM card_product WHERE category = #{category} AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY card_id
